transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. How can I help you today?

I’m here because I’ve been having trouble stopping my worries once they start. It can be about my mother getting up at night, or a grant report, or whether I missed something at work… and then I just can’t seem to put it away in my mind, even if I make lists or try to focus on something else.
Do you find that you worry excessively about a number of different things, such as work, family, health, or other everyday matters, even when there isn’t a clear reason to be concerned?

Yes… I think so. It used to mostly be about my mother and whether she was safe, but over the past year it’s kind of spread. Finances, decisions with staff, deadlines, the house… even whether I’m being a good daughter. Small things can start to feel like they’re about to unravel.
Do you notice any physical symptoms, like feeling restless, tense, or having trouble relaxing, especially when you’re worrying?

Yes… mostly tension, I guess. By the end of the day my neck and shoulders feel really tight, like I’ve been bracing myself without noticing. And I do catch myself clenching my jaw, especially when I’m answering emails or listening for my mother in the next room.
Have you noticed feeling down, hopeless, or losing interest in things you usually enjoy, even for periods of a few days or more?
I don’t think so… not hopeless, really. I get tired of everything sometimes, but I haven’t noticed losing interest in things for days at a time.
